title: Demodulating Soviet-French Venus balloon probe signal for JPL
place_text: Venus; Institute for Defense Analysis; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: the Russians and the French sent a probe to Hal's Comet the Probe on its way did a gravitational assist fly by a Venus while it was near Venus it dropped two balloon probes into the atmosphere of Venus

plain: A CIA contractor named Bob Maguire says that in the mid-1980s he worked on the signal from a Soviet and French space mission: a probe bound for Halley's Comet swung past Venus on the way and dropped two balloon probes into the planet's atmosphere. He tells Michels he decoded, or demodulated, the balloons' signal for the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's lab for space missions, work tied in the story to the Institute for Defense Analysis, a defense research body.
